description: This is a React component named 'Logo' that renders a company logo with fallback to a simple SVG-like placeholder if the image fails to load. It manages image resolution using environment variables and supports customization via props.

methods.name: Logo
methods.description: React functional component that displays a company logo with customizable size, alt text, and additional CSS classes. It attempts to load logo.png from public assets and falls back to a stylized placeholder if loading fails.
